create.name: Masood Ali Khan
create.bio:
Masood Ali Khan was born in London to parents of Indian Muslim heritage and has practised yoga for more than twenty-five years. He studied Chinese medicine in Colombo, Sri Lanka, where he also taught a system of universal energy practice, and later completed a long Rasa Yoga teacher training with Sianna Sherman, his partner and frequent co-teacher. He spent around eight years in professional training with the psychotherapist and author Robert Augustus Masters, learning to guide shadow work, and took part in men's ritual work with the West African teacher Malidoma Somé.

His teaching brings together movement, breath, mantra and music. On the yoga festival circuit he is known for playing the handpan while chanting Sanskrit mantras, and he has released several albums of devotional music. Through Rasa Heart Warrior he runs small online groups for men that combine shadow work, breathwork, meditation and drumming, with a weekly Saturday practice. At Esalen he leads a weekend of embodiment and men's council, and co-teaches a five-day Mythic Yoga Flow retreat with Sianna Sherman that pairs yoga with the stories and archetypes of the Indian tradition. He has also taught at Omega Institute and at festivals in Europe and Asia.

courses.title: Rasa Heart Warrior: Embodiment and Reset for Men
courses.description: A residential weekend at Esalen for men who want to reconnect with their bodies and with each other. It mixes Rasa Yoga and Foundation Training movement, breathwork, drumming, chanting and men's council, along with paired shadow-work exercises and reflection on archetypes such as the Warrior and the Lover.

courses.title: Mythic Yoga Flow: A Full Moon Retreat with the Stories and Practices of Yoga
courses.description: A five-day Esalen retreat co-taught with Sianna Sherman, in which each day follows a theme from yoga mythology such as Shiva and Shakti or Hanuman. Days combine asana, pranayama, mantra, mudra, meditation and guided journeys, with energising mornings and quieter afternoons.

courses.title: Rasa Heart Warrior Men's Group
courses.description: An ongoing online group for men, held on Zoom and limited to small numbers. Shadow-work circles meet twice a month and a Saturday morning session offers guided breathwork, meditation and movement; BIPOC-only and mixed groups are available.
